name: BACH_0131
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-4 case with a single-class conformal set [F1], though 4 of 5 similar cases are InSitu.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 98%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 0% | Strongly favors Benign; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (α = 10%, 90% coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile [F6] | Passes QC; atypical versus training set |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign, 4/5 InSitu (20%) [F5] | Nearest neighbors mostly InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.55; contribution +0.93), but 0/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.75; contribution +0.78); 20/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.25; contribution -0.74) opposes invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 11) · ↓ invasive · Elevated (+1.21; contribution -0.31), caption-inconsistent; 18/20 AI spot-check · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 2, 3, 6) · context · 91% neoplastic nuclei (100th percentile) [F7]; 3,426/mm² (97th percentile) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); top driver **Normal lobules** (0/20) and **mitoses** (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Dense proliferation in regions 2, 3, 6 is InSitu, matching 4 of 5 nearest neighbors (including contrast case BACH_0193).
- High-risk regions 2 (risk 0.50) and 6 (risk 0.43) contain true neoplastic cells rather than HoVer-Net false positives.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 6**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (up to 0.50) with 135–191 segmented neoplastic nuclei and immune proximity [F9].
2. **Regions 0, 1**: Check duct confinement and nuclear pleomorphism separating this case from InSitu contrast case BACH_0193.
3. **Regions 4, 11**: Verify benign tubules and fibrous stroma where region invasive risk is near zero.
